title: Collateral Desk Table: Small-Unit Loading on Equipment & Vehicle Loans Total-Loss Releases
content:
**Rule.** An Equipment & Vehicle Loans total-loss release premium carries a small-unit loading set by the destroyed unit's pledged value against the pledged value of all units still securing the loan: 10 points are added when it is less than 15 percent of that value, 5 points when it is at least 15 percent but less than one third, and nothing when it is one third or more. The loading is added to the product's partial release premium percentage before that percentage is applied once to the unit's share of principal.

## Values compared

- **The destroyed unit's pledged value** — from its pledge record.
- **The pledged value of all units still securing the loan** — every unit pledged less every unit since released, the destroyed unit, not yet released, among them.

## Loading by proportion

| Destroyed unit's pledged value as a share of the value still securing the loan | Points added |
|---|---|
| less than 15 percent | 10 |
| at least 15 percent but less than one third | 5 |
| one third or more | none |

## Both sides of each line (hypothetical: units still securing the loan pledged at 300000.00)

| Destroyed unit pledged at | Share | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| 44999.00 | below 15 percent | 10 |
| 45000.00 | exactly 15 percent | 5 |
| 99999.00 | below one third | 5 |
| 100000.00 | exactly one third | none |
